purpose: One-machine preview resource check, not a user study or a real Claude workload benchmark
environment: Windows x64 development build, visible window, reduced motion

protocol.cpu: Sum of per-process cumulativeCPUUsage deltas divided by monotonic wall time, times 100. 100% means one logical core fully used; not normalized by logical core count.
protocol.memory: Sum of Electron app.getAppMetrics memory.workingSetSize KiB, divided by 1024. Shared pages can be counted once per process; this is not unique physical footprint.
protocol.workload: Normal foreground window. First stage has zero stations. Second injects 200 synthetic SessionStart events into the real inbox/reducer/UI; then measures settled idle stations with no further events. Reduced motion enabled.
protocol.excluded: Claude processes, observer startup cost, 200-event ingestion burst, animation cost, startup cost, sustained event throughput, long-term leaks, packaged builds, OS sleep/resume, multi-screen scaling, controller CPU, GPU hardware utilization.
protocol.processChurn: If a process appears/disappears between readings its final interval CPU is unavailable; raw readings are retained and any churn makes the preview budget verdict inconclusive/false.

stages.name: idle
stages.animations: Idle stations; reduced-motion media preference enabled

stages.name: synthetic200Idle
stages.animations: Idle stations; reduced-motion media preference enabled

privacy: Public summary only. Machine identifiers, hardware inventory, display bounds, process IDs, creation times and per-process samples are retained only in local ignored outputs.
